test_title: PYST 36: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people, K, L, M, N, O and Z, are sitting in a straight row facing north(but not necessarily in the same order). No one sits to the left of M. Only three people sit between M and K. Only three people sit to the right of O. Z sits to the immediate left of O. N is not an immediate neighbour of O. Who sits at the rightmost end of the line?
solution: Given: Six people, K, L, M, N, O and Z, are sitting in a straight row facing north(but not necessarily in the same order). 1)No one sits to the left of M. 2) Only three people sit between M and K. 3) Only three people sit to the right of O.
